cues: Polarized light can be made in five ways.
By reflection: the glare from a wet road or a lake is largely polarized.
By refraction, through a pile of glass plates.
By selective absorption, in a Polaroid sheet.
By double refraction, in a calcite crystal.
And by scattering: look at the blue sky at right angles to the Sun through a Polaroid, and turn it.
